title: Cold Stare
description: Minimal sigma stare edit: extreme close-ups on the eyes, freeze frames and zoom ladders on the beat, monochrome with one red accent and massive condensed type.

recipe.look: bw-contrast with a red accent on titles only, heavy grain, deep vignette
recipe.energy: Few cuts (≤1 per second) but a zoom ladder (stepped punch-ins) on every beat, freeze frames on accents, one hard flash at the climax.

structure.guidance: Static extreme close-up; nothing moves but a slow blink.
Stepped zoom punches toward the eyes on each beat; words stack beside the face.
Flash, freeze on the eyes, title word in red.

recipe.titles: Huge Anton words filling the frame width, slam animation, one word per beat.
recipe.music: Slow, heavy beat with long reverb; space between hits matters.
recipe.generation: One or two keyframes are enough: an extreme close-up and a medium shot; animate with very subtle I2V motion (blink, breath).

prompt: @image1 stares through the lens without emotion; keep every facial detail identical to the photo.
author: open-katana
